A second parallax study with layered depth, built around a coastal landing-page hero for Achilles Point.A second parallax study with layered depth, built around a coastal landing-page hero for Achilles Point.

The challenge

A landing-page hero that has to:

  • Give depth and movement
  • Keep one clear message and one action

The approach

The headline "Achilles" is filled with the coastline itself, so the image shows through the letters while foreground bush and rocks sit on their own layers in front.

The details

  • Navigation: Home, Customize, Pricing, Our Work, Contact
  • Short intro on Achilles Point’s rocky coastline, native bush and Rangitoto Island view
  • Single pill-shaped "Book Now" action

My role

UI designVisual compositionParallax animationPrototyping

Design process

LayoutA landing page with one message
LayersForeground bush and rocks on their own layers
TypeThe headline filled with the coastline
MotionLayers moving at different speeds, in Figma
InterfaceNavigation and one "Book Now" action
how it landed

OutcomeOutcome

A design study, so these are the signals it is designed to improve, not live numbers.

What I delivered

  • A layered parallax hero designed and animated in Figma
  • A headline filled with the coastline image
  • A landing-page interface with one clear "Book Now" action

How I’d measure success

  • How far visitors scroll past the hero
  • Clicks on "Book Now"
  • Time spent on the first screen

What it shows

  • Motion and depth in interface design
  • Image-in-type composition
  • Restraint: one action, one message
